scripts.test: pnpm run build && node -e "if(!fs.globSync('tests/**/*.test.mjs').length){console.error('no test files matched');process.exit(1)}" && node --test "tests/**/*.test.mjs" && pnpm -r test
scripts.lint: node scripts/lint-boundaries.mjs && node scripts/check-single-copy.mjs pnpm-lock.yaml && eslint .
scripts.check:pack: pnpm run build && pnpm -r exec pnpm pack --pack-destination "$PWD/node_modules/.pack" >/dev/null && for f in node_modules/.pack/*.tgz; do publint run --strict "$f" && attw --profile esm-only "$f" || s=1; done && exit ${s:-0}
